basis: M10W22 outcome-blind causal-information availability audit only. No future return, PF, PnL, win/loss labels, or outcome correlation was used to choose these formulas.
target_regime: D1 EMA20>EMA30>EMA40 AND H4 EMA20>EMA30 AND H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4)>0 AND H1 Wilder ATR14 percentile100>=0.67

common.decision_grid: M15 decision timestamps from M10W22 target-regime causal rows
common.entry: Exact M1 execution at decision timestamp; ask=M1 open + spread_points*point
common.exit: Exact M1 timestamp +240 minutes; bid=M1 open

MVI1_LONG_M5_VOLUME_IMPULSE.hypothesis: In the already bullish/high-ATR regime, a broad-range M5 bullish impulse accompanied by above-average tick activity may provide a cleaner continuation entry than MACD/EMA/RCI timing.
MVI1_LONG_M5_VOLUME_IMPULSE.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: volume above trailing-20 mean, body at least half of candle range, close in upper third

MWR1_LONG_M5_PULLBACK_REJECTION.hypothesis: A recently negative micro-pullback that closes with a pronounced lower-wick rejection may provide a causal pullback-completion entry.
MWR1_LONG_M5_PULLBACK_REJECTION.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: non-positive prior 15-minute move, lower wick at least 40% of bar, close in upper 40%

MMO1_LONG_M1_MICRO_MOMENTUM.hypothesis: Short-horizon upward micro-momentum immediately before the M15 decision may identify continuation timing without relying on the failed higher-timeframe indicator triggers.
MMO1_LONG_M1_MICRO_MOMENTUM.threshold_origin: semantic/no-outcome: positive 5-minute return, majority of five M1 closes up, latest M1 closes in upper 40%

outcome_blind_density_check.note: Counts were checked only to avoid structurally unusable density; no outcomes were inspected.

decision_tiers.REJECT: Any split PF <=1.0 with adequate count, or all-sample fixed0p20 PF <=1.0, or all-sample extra2bps PF <=1.0.

frozen_evaluation.fresh_shadow_rule: Only ROBUST_CANDIDATE or STRONG_CANDIDATE may advance to a new independent fresh prospective shadow. Historical support alone is not final support.
